title: Refresh onboarding guide for new API users
objective: Reduce avoidable onboarding confusion for new API users
audience: Developers evaluating and integrating the API for the first time
problem: Users cannot distinguish prerequisites, first successful request, and common setup failures
desiredAction: Complete the first successful request and continue to integration guidance

claims.text: The documented quickstart reflects the current supported setup

dependencies: Product review of current setup flow
risks: Derivative tutorials depend on this guide

metrics.primary: Successful progression from quickstart to integration guide
guardrails: Support tickets caused by onboarding instructions

assumptions: The target audience already has the minimum account access described in prerequisites
openQuestions: Which current setup failure accounts for the largest avoidable support volume?
